payload.comment: All structured data in the reporting-stage artefacts is internally consistent and numerically verified. Key cross-checks pass: (1) confusion-matrix row sums equal per-class supports (total 7180); (2) accuracy 6462/7180 = 0.9000; (3) per-class precision, recall, and F1 all reproduce from the matrix; (4) macro metrics (precision 0.879297, recall 0.878031, F1 0.870039) are correct means; (5) abstention arithmetic is exact (abstain_rate + test_coverage = 1.0; human_review_count = 7180 × 0.463231 = 3326; selective_risk = 1 − 0.988324 = 0.011676); (6) OOD aggregate AUROC 0.9758 = mean of predictive-entropy test scores across σ levels; (7) cosine LR schedule verified at epochs 1, 10, 15; (8) training history is monotonic in loss and consistent with best_epoch = 15. No deterministic findings. The warning-level issues are documentation and narrative completeness gaps, not data-integrity failures: (a) the ~9.7 pp validation-to-test accuracy gap (0.997 → 0.900) and the ~26 pp coverage gap (80.0% val → 53.7% test) should be explicitly flagged as caveats in the final report rather than left implicit; (b) the provenance distinction between best_configuration.validation_accuracy (0.982707, selection trial) and train_result.best_val_accuracy (0.997001, final replay) should be documented; (c) LLM-generated prose contains a recurring factual error ('96×96 patch resolution' vs actual 28×28×3) and llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8, limiting narrative reproducibility; (d) OOD evaluation is limited to Gaussian-noise corruptions (properly scoped as 'controlled_corruption_proxy') with no true distributional-shift test; (e) no per-class abstention rates are reported, leaving it unclear whether the mechanism preferentially covers weak classes (cancer-associated stroma recall 0.485, smooth muscle recall 0.823). None of these invalidate the numerical results; they are report-completeness items that should be addressed in the final narrative before external distribution.
llm_issues: Val-test accuracy gap (~9.7 pp, 0.997→0.900) and val-test coverage gap (~26 pp, 80.0%→53.7%) are not explicitly flagged as caveats in the abstention or evaluation reports; downstream users may over-expect generalization.

Provenance distinction between best_configuration.validation_accuracy (0.982707, selection trial) and train_result.best_val_accuracy (0.997001, final replay) is not documented in the evaluation report.
Recurring LLM prose error: '96×96 patch resolution' appears in multiple narrative artefacts but actual image_shape_hwc is [28,28,3]; structured data is correct, prose is wrong.
llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama); LLM-generated narrative steps lack content-hash pinning, limiting full reproducibility of prose artefacts.

OOD evaluation is limited to unit-scale Gaussian-noise corruptions (σ 0.15/0.25/0.4); no true distributional-shift or domain-shift OOD test is included; scope label 'controlled_corruption_proxy' is present but the practical limitation should be more prominently stated in the final report.

No per-class abstention rates are reported; given low recall for cancer-associated stroma (0.485) and smooth muscle (0.823), it is unclear whether the abstention mechanism preferentially covers these weak classes.

Per-class test metrics for debris (n=339) and cancer-associated stroma (n=421) have wide confidence intervals given small support and distribution shift; no CI or power note is included in the evaluation report.
